programme.desc: A psychological thriller about a man who has become trapped in a time and place which may or may not exist and is faced with events which similarly may or may not be happening. programme.title: Memory of the Dead

programme.desc: A dark story of madness, pain and love: A young man loses his girlfriend in a park after getting distracted for a short moment; A lonely girl obsessed with crime news and killers starts a trip into the world of evil; A serial killer keeps killing women in the city; and a man of great faith realizes that a dark power lurks waiting for more victims.

programme.title: New World Order
programme.desc: While a college student is researching social phobias, she comes across the term "noon blue apples," which takes her on a journey into the paranormal. As she delves deeper into the world of conspiracy, all that she believed about politics, history and religion are suddenly cast into extreme doubt. -Starring Lauren Fox, Susan Greenhill, George Takei

programme.title: Hidden Moon
programme.desc: The son (Wes Bentley) of a wealthy man whose funeral is disrupted by the presence of a mysterious Latin American woman (Ana Serradilla), sets out to salvage his family's reputation by figuring out the exact nature of the woman's relationship with his deceased father. Starring Wes Bentley, Ana Serradilla, Johnathon Schaech

programme.title: Generation Wolf
programme.desc: Generation Wolf talks about a young entrepreneur who is about to lose his business and choose to grow marijuana as an easy way to save it. But soon enough he realizes that crossing the line could have extreme consequences into his life. Starring Christian de la Cortina, Hayley Sales, Michael D. Cohen

programme.title: Dragon Inn Part 1: The City of Sadness [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: An action noir film about a vigilante who rules justice on seemingly ordinary Chinese inns, but actually pass judgments on cases that the law has failed to judge.

programme.title: DRAGON INN PART 2 : THE NIGHT OF SALVATION [English Sub]
programme.desc: Dragon Inn takes a case of a missing girl. She had no reason to run away from home, which makes the situation quite suspicious. While investigating her case, they find out that a pseudo religion is implicated. Trying to find more information of the girl, Seung-jin makes a mistake and their location and identities are exposed. Will they be able to defeat the cult and save the girl from them?

programme.title: Fukushima 50 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Workers at the Fukushima Daiichi facility in Japan risk their lives and stay at the nuclear power plant to prevent total destruction after the region is devastated by an earthquake and tsunami in 2011.

programme.title: Firefighters [English Dub]
programme.desc: Even in the harshest environments, firefighters must focus on extinguishing fires and rescuing everyone there. At 3:47 AM on March 4, 2001, the 119 emergency call center receives a phone call about a fire that has broken out in the Hongje-dong neighborhood. Firefighters, including newcomer Cheol-woong, rush to the scene.

programme.title: Oh Lucy! [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Bored Tokyo lady Setsuko (Independent Spirit Award-nominee Shinobu Terajima) breaks free of her monotonous life when her niece, Mika (Shioli Kutsuna) convinces her to enroll in an unorthodox English class. There, she adopts a blonde-haired alter ego name 'Lucy' and develops romantic feelings for her American instructor, John (Josh Hartnett).But after his sudden disappearance, Setsuko follows his trail halfway around the world to Southern California, where family ties and past lives are tested as she struggles to fulfill the promise of 'Lucy.'

programme.title: Pushing Hands [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Having just moved from Beijing, elderly tai chi master Mr. Chu (Sihung Lung) struggles to adjust to life in New York, living with his Americanized son Alex (Ye-tong Wang). Chu immediately butts heads with his put-upon white daughter-in-law, Martha (Deb Snyder), a writer who seems to blame him for her own paralyzing inability to focus. But when Chu begins teaching tai chi at a local school, his desire to make a meaningful connection comes to fruition in the most unexpected of ways. PUSHING HANDS is the debut film from Oscar-winning director Ang Lee, forming the first chapter in his 'Father Knows Best' trilogy, which depicts the tensions between the traditional Confucian values of the older generation and the realities of modern life. Co-written by collaborator James Schamus, PUSHING HANDS was selected by the 1992 Berlin International Film Festival and won three Golden Horse Awards, paving the way for Lee's worldwide success with films such as CROUCHING TIGER, HIDDEN DRAGON and BROKEBACK MOUNTAIN. Presented in a new 2K restoration.

programme.title: THE PRIESTS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A priest and a skeptical young deacon try to save a girl who falls into a mysterious coma after a hit-and-run. Suspecting demonic possession, they perform an exorcism, but as they uncover the entity’s dark origins, they face a terrifying battle of faith and survival.

programme.title: You Will Die in 6 Hours [English Sub]
programme.desc: Jung-yoon was approached by a random stranger named Jun-woo, who told her she'd be dead in six hours. As she follows him for answers, she begins to question whether he's her savior or the one trying to put her in danger.

programme.title: The Tooth and the Nail [English Sub]
programme.desc: In Seoul, a soon after acquiring independence from Japanese occupation, two men met and there came the sound of six shots firing. The police arrests Nam Do-jin, the wealthiest man as a suspect for the murder of a driver named Choi Seung-man. However, all they could find was a burnt body, blood spots, and chopped off fingers. As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.

programme.title: The Big Swindle [English Subtitle]

After the bank is robbed, the police learn that the anonymous caller who helped them catch some members is a girlfriend of one of the swindlers and that she might be holding the key to solving the mysterious disappearance of money.

programme.desc: Voted one of the hundred funniest comics of all time by Comedy Central, Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy.

programme.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
programme.desc: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

programme.title: Helen Hong: Well Hong
programme.desc: Standup comic Helen Hong recounts spending her COVID-19 quarantine trying to date doomsday preppers and trying to teach the world that China is not the only country in Asia.

programme.title: Jeff Garcia
programme.desc: Jeff Garcia aims to give audiences their money's worth with his signature original shows in this 2008 special.

programme.title: Joe Devito: First of All...
programme.desc: Navigating the world of dating over 40 is akin to embarking on a thrift store shopping spree, and Joe DeVito is no stranger to the game; with wit and wisdom, DeVito captures the hilarious truths of dating in this age bracket.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programme.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programme.desc: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programme.desc: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
programme.desc: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

programme.title: Boonie Bears : The Big Shrink
programme.desc: After purchasing a mysterious shrink ray machine, Vick accidentally shrinks Briar, Bramble, and himself. The tiny team must put aside their differences and embark on one big journey to restore their size and their friendship.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.title: Racetime
programme.desc: Frankie and Sophie challenge newcomers Zac and Charlie to an epic sled race.

programme.title: Son of Bigfoot
programme.desc: A teenage boy journeys to find his missing father only to discover that he's actually Bigfoot.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: The lovable Ozzy’s pampered life is thrown into turmoil after his family drops him at Blue Creek before their vacation. Ozzy quickly learns that Blue Creek is a dog prison and he’ll need to rely on some new friends to help him break out and get back home.

programme.title: Stardog & Turbocat
programme.desc: A loyal dog and a vigilante cat embark on a space age voyage to find their way home.

programme.title: Rally Road Racers
programme.desc: A rookie race-car driver gets the opportunity to compete against the reigning champion. With help from a former driver, he must overcome treacherous terrain, rival racers and unexpected obstacles to prove he has what it takes.

programme.title: Cats
programme.desc: A cat named Blanket lives in the city with his son, Cape. One day, Cape decides to leave home and embarks on an adventure to find the legendary cat's paradise. To find his son, Blanket must overcome his fear and reconcile with his past.

programme.title: Tall Tales
programme.desc: When his beloved Queen bee Marguerite is kidnapped, vagabond cricket Apollo who has been framed for the crime, teams up with the other bugs to save the Queen and the entire kingdom.

programme.title: Luis and the Aliens
programme.desc: A boy at risk of being sent to boarding school by his Dad - and three aliens stranded due to watching too much TV - must help each other out.

programme.title: Mission to the Moon
programme.desc: In the international race to the moon, the Norwegian mission is led by brilliant inventor Reodor from the village of Flaklypa. With Louis the Magpie as the brave astronaut, what could possibly go wrong? Quite a bit, actually – on the daring mission, secret passengers are discovered, hidden agendas are revealed, and nothing seems to work out the way it was planned. Louis and his friend Luca the Hedgehog are in for some surprises on their trip to the moon. The third film in the stop-motion trilogy featuring the beloved characters from the Flaklypa universe.

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. Spoiled and innocent, chubby house cat Marnie lives a comfortable and pampered life in the Sunshine household. She has never ventured outside the family home and only knows about the real world through her favourite detective, crime TV-shows.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy and Ivan have failed their runes exam and have to do it over - or they won’t be allowed to attend the Doom Wolves concert. But their study session ends up putting themselves, and the Doom Wolves, in grave danger!

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

programme.desc: Joyce joins the local watercolour society for an open-air art class, upon the village green in Midsomer Florey. When Barnaby is taken off the case by the NIS, it is left to Troy to 'apprehensively' let Barnaby in on what's going on with the investigation.

programme.desc: At the family home of actor Larry Smith in the village of Upper Warden, a crowd has gathered to watch the promotion for the sequel to his hit film 'The House of Satan', when Larry walks into a summerhouse house in the grounds, it suddenly explodes. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: In the village of Midsomer Magna, the body of a man is found who had apparently drowned himself. The post-mortem says that he was indeed murdered. Whilst DS Troy assists a pretty wildlife liaison officer with an investigation into the illegal sale of protected birds eggs.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: During a canal restoration project near Midsomer Worthy, on which Joyce is working as a volunteer, several skeletons are discovered shortly after a tunnel collapse. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DS Dan Scott, a charming young man but with a bit of an urban chip on his shoulder, arrives in Midsomer as DS Troy's replacement. Not long after, a retired doctor for whom she had worked is murdered during the village's annual garden open day. programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Back in 1970, Roger Heldman died in what appeared to be an accident, during a dig at Midsomer Barrow. It unearthed two important Celtic pieces, a spear and chalice. At the climax of the summer solstice celebration Gareth's half brother David Heartley-Reade is killed while performing a ceremony to save his failing marriage.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby and DS Scott arrive in Midsomer St. Michael to investigate the apparently accidental death of former prize-winning author Richard Rackham. When Mr Rackham's editor is then found dead during the festival's opening ceremony, it leads police on a trail of deception, fraud, and hidden truths.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Esmeraldas

Al mismo tiempo, Eduardo encuentra la tan anhelada Titiguaca, poniéndolo en el ojo del huracán.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Agustino y su esposa son asesinados, sin embargo, la hija de la pareja logra escapar y le cuenta toda la verdad a Alejandro. Mientras tanto, Eduardo sigue obsesionado con la Titiguaca. Tiempo después, Alcira es la amante del Alcalde, quien le regala una finca.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Alejandro enfrenta a Ortega con el fin de que deje en paz a su hijo, Alcira y Eduardo son descubiertos por el Alcalde, manteniendo relaciones, en consecuencia, enfurecido intenta matar al joven, pero es Eduardo quien termina con su vida aplastándole la cabeza con una piedra.

programme.title: Esmeraldas

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Olga confiesa que no ama a Alcides ni quiere casarse. Alejandro decide olvidar a Alicia y buscar a Reina. Eduardo excava en la finca de Alcira y sigue hallando esmeraldas. Esmeralda descubre que su padre negocia con el Zarco Gutiérrez, junto a Gladys lo enfrenta por esos tratos, desatando tensiones familiares y conflictos en la región.

programme.title: Poco Más de Un Año
programme.desc: Después de caerse del techo en una fiesta de Año Nuevo, Owen decide que es hora de hacer algunos cambios radicales en su vida. Durante el año siguiente, deja de beber, vuelve a entrar en la vida de su hijo del que estaba separado, reaviva viejas amistades, se enamora... y pronto descubre que a veces en la vida sólo se necesita un pequeño cambio.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: La prometedora doctora superestrella April tiene la vida perfecta. Trabaja en un prestigioso hospital de Nueva York y recientemente conoció a un apuesto veterinario llamado Jesse.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

Su postre llama la atención (y el sabor) de Kate, y pronto descubren que la receta para la verdadera felicidad es una pizca de trabajo en equipo y mucho amor.

programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Lucía se besa con Melo delante de todos a pesar de la prohibición de su padre. Esa misma noche, Esmeralda escapa de la casa. Por otra parte, Alejandro le confiesa al Alcalde que está enamorado de Reina, mientras el pueblo es acosado por maleantes que destruyen todo a su paso.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Cuando ortega se entera que su prima sale con Alejandro, se enfurece. Ese día, cuando los maleantes se meten a la finca de Alcides, los campesinos se defienden y hieren a la novia del Zarco. Mientras tanto, Olga continúa empeñada en no casarse y en conquistar al Padre Javier.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo le pide a Esmeralda que sean novios, obviamente al estar enamorada de Ricardo lo rechaza, días después de haber hecho una denuncia radial de la situación en la Victoria, el reportero amigo de Alejandro es asesinado. programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega pierde las licitaciones y Eduardo lo obliga a dejar la casa con su hija, luego roba y desaparece a Alcira. Más tarde, los Guerrero sufren una explosión en la mina que los deja atrapados. Tras horas de esfuerzo, Alejandro, Ricardo y Alcides son rescatados, dejando a Ortega frustrado por no lograr matarlos.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El segundo derrumbe atrapa la pierna de Alcides. Esa noche Reina confronta a Ortega, quien la amenaza de muerte. Eduardo se une a uno de los caciques de la zona para acabar con Ortega y con el Zarco, logrando someterlos y capturarlos. Días después, Olga termina por comprometerse con Alcides cuando él queda en silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo obliga a Esmeralda a comprometerse. Alcira regresa para denunciarlo y recuperar sus tierras, lo que divide a la familia tras enfrentarlo Alejandro y Ricardo. Días después, Olga se casa con Alcides y Esmeralda con Eduardo, quien ordena asesinar a Ortega a manos de “El Tigre” y “El Cascabel”.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, Eduardo es culpado por varios crímenes, pero su hermano Ricardo logra detenerlo antes de que sea atrapado por la Policía. Tras 20 años de cárcel, Eduardo cumple su condena y es liberado.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo rechaza a toda su familia, haciendo alianzas políticas para quitarle las minas a su papá y hermanos, Esmeralda se encuentra con Ricardo, a pesar de que él no la ha olvidado, ella lo rechaza pues no pretende volver al estar apurada intentando sacar a su hijo de la Victoria. Más adelante, Eduardo se encuentra con Esmeralda cuando a él le hacen un atentado.
